correctness.rationale: The proof partitions by the number of marginals without attained top atoms. A top-vector hit establishes convergence to one when all are positive. A deterministically tie-broken maximizing index of the sole exceptional coordinate is measurable with respect to that coordinate sample and independent of the other coordinate arrays; its chance of attaining every other upper endpoint is exactly the product of those endpoint masses. For the converse, projection reduces to two exceptional marginals. The maximum-index probability g_Y(n)=E[F_Y(Y)^(n-1)] tends to zero by dominated convergence because a marginal without a top atom has F_Y(Y)<1 a.s. Every threshold with q=P(X>t)>0 then yields a_n<=(1-q)^n+n q g_Y(n). Since positive upper-tail probabilities q can be arbitrarily small, selecting q_k<min(1/k,k/N_k), n_k=ceil(k/q_k), where g_Y(n)<=1/k^2 for n>=N_k, proves a_nk<=e^(-k)+(k+q_k)/k^2->0. For the atomless exceptional coordinate, unique maximization and a union bound over missing upper endpoints give the stated exponential error estimate. Exact rational enumeration and binomial identities check representative cases but are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2022 paper explicitly poses independent-coordinate questions about infinitely many marginal values and all-but-one finite supports; its inspected Propositions 3 and 9 provide restricted sufficient cases. The new complete heterogeneous-product classification uses terminal top-atom counts rather than support cardinalities, handles arbitrary atomic and infinite marginals, and proves the nontrivial rare-threshold subsequence obstruction. The 2022 quasi-unidimensional and 2025 geometric-mapping followups address different dependence structures. Broad and exact candidate-specific published and database queries located no covering theorem; an implicit general argmax/occupancy criterion remains the main residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent upper-endpoint classification could be implicit in general argmax-intersection, occupancy, maximal-elements or order-statistics literature under terminology not captured by the focused searches.

value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly asks for criteria in the independent-coordinate product setting, including infinite-valued marginals and all-but-one finite-valued cases. The theorem supplies a complete, simple and exact distribution-level iff test across all dimensions and all heterogeneous marginal laws. It resolves both motivating questions, exposes why support cardinality alone is the wrong invariant, and establishes the nontrivial absence-of-leaders subsequence for irregular atomic laws where smooth maxima arguments fail. The atomless sharpness limit and exponential finite-sample bound are useful quantitative refinements rather than routine numerical increments.
